hints.title: Three Alternating Phases
hints.text: The sequence must follow three consecutive non-empty phases: strictly increasing, strictly decreasing, then strictly increasing.

hints.title: Peak and Valley Identifiers
hints.text: Advance an index through the first ascent, then the descent, then the final ascent.

hints.title: Boundary Validation
hints.text: Verify each phase consumes at least one step and reaches the final index of the array.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Advances a single pointer linearly through the three monotonicity stages.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible peak-valley index pairs would take quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear scan needs zero extra memory allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the state transition conditions and enforce strict inequalities.
